_about: Named places in the kit's one world (1930s downtown block + the corner grocery). p = where 'center' stands (metres), az = camera side (0 = camera on +z looking -z). max = widest shot size that fits (indoors the walls stop wider shots).

grocery_front.what: sidewalk in front of the corner grocery: striped awning, GROCERY sign, fruit display windows, open door

grocery_inside.what: inside the grocery: shelves full of cans and boxes, checker floor, pendant lamps

workshop.what: back-room workshop: pegboard with tools, workbench (inside THE OKLAHOMA NEWS building)

hats_shop.what: sidewalk at HATS & DRY GOODS (green awning)

newspaper.what: sidewalk at THE OKLAHOMA NEWS office, NEWS blade sign, street clock nearby

drugstore.what: sidewalk at the DRUG STORE (red awning)

bank.what: sidewalk at the FIRST NATIONAL BANK: stone front, 3 floors, water tank on the roof

cafe.what: sidewalk at the teal CAFE (orange awning)

hardware.what: sidewalk at HARDWARE (TOOLS blade sign), mailbox and hydrant nearby

five_and_dime.what: sidewalk at the FIVE & DIME (5c 10c sign)

street.what: middle of the street, camera looking down the long street with shop rows on both sides (open space for crowds, chases, big reveals)

insurance.what: far sidewalk at the INSURANCE office: stone front, 4 floors

diner.what: far sidewalk at the teal DINER (red awning)

department_store.what: far sidewalk at the DEPARTMENT STORE (KERR'S)

radio_shop.what: far sidewalk at the RADIO SHOP

jeweler.what: far sidewalk at the JEWELER (WATCHES blade sign)
